parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood panels forming the sides, back, and top.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and defines the overall shape of the cabinet, holding the door, base, and shelves in place.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports all other components.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a solid wood panel attached to the front of the cabinet with hinges and a handle.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space and protects the contents from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom support structure of the cabinet, typically made of MDF for stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and ensures it stands level on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for storing or organizing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable vertically but does not move during regular use.
